I implemented `tax_for(amount_cents, rate)` in `src/billing/tax.py`. It takes integer cents and returns integer cents, rounded with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` as the stored finance decision requires.

The multiplication is done in `Decimal`, so no float touches the money. The rate can be a `Decimal`, a string or a float. A float rate like `0.07` is converted through `str()` so it doesn't pick up binary noise.

I added tests to `tests/test_tax.py` for the half-even tie cases (72.5 rounds to 72, 7.5 rounds to 8) and for a float rate. pytest isn't installed here, so I called the test functions directly instead. They passed, along with the existing `test_line_total`.

I didn't save any new memories. The two relevant ones (integer cents, banker's rounding) were already stored and the code matches them.
